p: בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (יִתְרוֹ, חֵלֶק ב פח, ב)
"Of the night of Shabbos it is written (Yeshayahu 58:14):
'And I will make you ride upon the high places of the earth.'"
And in the Gemara (Shabbos 118b) it is brought:
"He is saved from subjugation to the kingdoms;
it is written here, 'And I will make you ride,' etc.,
'And you shall tread upon their high places.'"
are the roots of the kelipos,
and the first of the kelipah is Amalek,
and it stands against the holiness of the bris,
that they would cut off the circumcised parts
there are those who blemish this.
the dominion of the nations of the world
And opposite this is Yosef the tzaddik,
and "whoever is circumcised is called a tzaddik,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ וָאֵרָא, חֵלֶק ב כג, א)
as is written (holy Zohar, Va'eira, II 23a).
at the hand of the offspring of Yosef,
"And the house of Yosef a flame,
וּבֵית עֵשָׂו לְקַשׁ (רְאֵה בָּבָא בַתְרָא קכג, ב).
and the house of Esav for straw" (see Bava Basra 123b).

that the serpent came upon Chavah

that the holiness of the Ushpizin
of his holiness upon all of Israel.

And the Shabbos that comes during Sukkos,

and that they will merit to vanquish

And likewise there depends on this
the victory over the nations of the world,
in the root of the seven nations,
and since each one comprises ten,
they are the seventy kelipos of the nations.
